svg.title: Circle of Fourths — Classroom Reference
svg.desc: C starts at twelve o’clock. Move clockwise through the flat keys. Major key and accidental count form the core, key signature and relative minor the middle ring, and two-octave xylophone scales the outer ring. Separated, graduated percussion bars run low to high from left to right. Green bars with note names belong to the scale. Notes below each diagram begin on its tonic.
svg.text: Move clockwise through the flat keys.
